capture.title: Capture
capture.hint: What gets recorded — applies live, no restart

wireTrace.label: Wire trace
wireTrace.hint: Raw GSX / gateway frames to a separate CMTrace file

mirror.label: Mirror to session log
mirror.hint: Copies warnings and errors into the session event file, in order with the flight events, so one file tells the whole story

keepVerbose.label: Keep verbose logging
keepVerbose.hint: Debug levels and the wire trace switch themselves off after 24 hours. Tick to keep them on.

capture.verboseNotice: Verbose logging on since {0} — back to Information at {1}.
capture.verboseKept: Verbose logging on since {0} and kept on; the log files grow accordingly.

telemetry.label: Telemetry API
telemetry.hint: Read-only: serves session event logs and log tails over the web server for post-flight checks. Other devices need the access token

capture.filesAfter: are CMTrace format for live viewing in CMTrace.

support.title: Support
support.hint: One zip with everything a bug report needs

sessions.label: Session files
sessions.hint: Newest session event logs to include

days.label: Log days
days.hint: Newest daily app logs to include

wire.label: Include wire trace
wire.hint: Raw GSX / gateway frames for the same days — large; only when asked for

support.bundleBefore: The bundle holds the newest session event logs, the app logs, a copy of settings.json with every key and token redacted, and the version banner, with a manifest of file hashes. Attach it to a GitHub issue on psyraxaus/ProsimCompanion; "Copy version" puts
support.bundleAfter: on the clipboard for the issue text.
